name: Example Instruments Demo One patches
description: 3 patches for the Example Instruments Demo One from https://example.com/demo-one/owners-guide.pdf.

patches.name: Basic Bass
patches.description: A round saw bass with a short filter pluck.
patches.notes:
A round saw bass with a short filter pluck.

Play it low. The envelope opens the filter on every note through the normalled connection, so no cables are needed.

- Raise **Decay** for a longer pluck.
- Turn **Resonance** past 2:00 for a squelchier bass.

patches.name: Clocked Pluck
patches.description: A pitched pluck that retriggers from the clock and sweeps its own pitch. Source: Demo One Owner's Guide, by A. Example.
patches.notes:
A pitched pluck that retriggers from the clock and sweeps its own pitch.

With **Hold** on, the clock keeps retriggering the envelope at the **Tempo** rate.

- The negative **Env Amount** closes the filter as the envelope rises, so each note starts dark.
- Audio-rate FM from the oscillator into the cutoff adds the grit; pull the blue cable for a cleaner tone.

Source: [Demo One Owner's Guide](https://example.com/demo-one/owners-guide.pdf), p. 12, by A. Example.

patches.name: Resonant Whistle
patches.description: The filter at full resonance, played as a sine-like whistle.
patches.notes:
The filter at full resonance, played as a sine-like whistle.

At full **Resonance** the filter rings on its own. The cable lets the envelope push the whistle's pitch up on each note; leave **Env Amount** at center so only the cable moves it.
